Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Brown (K)
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 02/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 94 as introduced would extend the Alabama Commission on Tick Borne Illness through September 30, 2025 and allow for retroactive application. The Commission has been appropriated $75,000 from the Education Trust Fund (ETF) each fiscal year from 2018 to present. The Governor's Recommended ETF appropriation act for Fiscal Year 2023 also includes an appropriation of $75,000.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions
